name: kaipu
description: Kaipu Record — screen recorder monorepo: Electron desktop app, Hono API, web app, and shared DDD + Hexagonal packages

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format
scripts.verify: bun run check-workflows && bun run lint && oxfmt --check . && bun run build --filter='@kaipu/*' && bun run check-types && bun run test
scripts.db:push: bash scripts/with-env.sh --tags db-scripts -- turbo run db:push -F @kaipu/infra-db
scripts.db:studio: bash scripts/with-env.sh --tags db-scripts -- turbo run db:studio -F @kaipu/infra-db
scripts.db:generate: bash scripts/with-env.sh --tags db-scripts -- turbo run db:generate -F @kaipu/infra-db
scripts.db:migrate: bash scripts/with-env.sh --tags db-scripts -- turbo run db:migrate -F @kaipu/infra-db
scripts.test:integration: bash scripts/with-env.sh --tags db-scripts -- turbo run test:integration -F @kaipu/infra-db
